pick Door to Lower Galleries win

answer 1. I work for Nesh-Deeka. I got into Vicrium lower galleries (key lifted from Ah-Zish) and found the knights strongbox with an old parchment map: seven towers standing in the sea and a tooth-shaped crag on an island. It is a trail to the Eye of Argonia, a jewel said to heal every tree, at the Root under the sea; the Unbound are also after it. 2. Bring the map to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. 3. Go straight back to Helstrom; I could study the map myself first, but I see no other option. The smuggler here I can avoid. 4. I do not know where the seven towers or the tooth crag are, what the Eye really is, or what the Collector wants. Nesh-Deeka may know.

answer 1. I gave Nesh-Deeka the map. She says it is another step to the Eye of Argonia; her officer will read the towers and tooth crag. She knew the Unbound had not reached Vicrium and only said we listen. She named me Toh-Wo, Secret-Speaker, second rank, and paid 200 gold. 2. Choose the order gift, a rapier or a quarterstaff, from Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. 3. Take the rapier or the quarterstaff; as a stealthy character I lean to the rapier. 4. I do not know how she listens, who her officer is, what the Eye truly is, or what the Collector wants. I could ask Nesh-Deeka or her officer.

answer 1. I took the rapier from Nesh-Deeka. I now report to her officer Never-Writes-Twice, who is in the same room and will read the map of seven towers and a tooth-shaped crag. All of it is a trail to the Eye of Argonia. 2. Show the map to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka House. 3. Just talk to her; no other option is visible. 4. I still do not know what the Eye truly is, what the Collector wants, how the order listens, or where the towers and crag are. Never-Writes-Twice may explain.

answer 1. The quest Down into Vicrium is done. Never-Writes-Twice read the map: the tooth crag is the Grey Tooth, seamark of Skeith Isle, reached by boat to Archon and Arorha; she marked it. She warned me about Cuts-the-Old-Knot, once of the order, who went mad on sap and killed her minders, and told me not to listen to her. 2. No new objective is given; the next step seems to be Skeith Isle via a boat to Archon and Arorha. 3. I can seek a boat to Skeith Isle or ask the order for more. 4. I do not know what the seven towers are, what the Eye truly is, what the Collector wants, who Cuts-the-Old-Knot is now, or where Archon and Arorha lie.

answer I work for Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom; I am now Toh-Wo, Secret-Speaker, second rank, reporting to her officer Never-Writes-Twice. At Vicrium I lifted the lower-gallery key from Ah-Zish (persuade and paying gold did not hand it over, pickpocketing worked) and took an old parchment map from the knights strongbox: seven towers in the sea and a tooth crag. Never-Writes-Twice says the crag is the Grey Tooth, seamark of Skeith Isle, reached by boat to Archon and Arorha, and she marked it. She warned me off Cuts-the-Old-Knot, an ex-order member who went mad on sap and killed her minders. I carry Toh-Wo Rapier, 2 lockpicks, Unbound-Note, Voh-Vastei-Armour, Eye-Setting, Kothringi Keystone, Grave-Stake, bronze disc, 3 Grey Seal, the map, about 850 gold after the key payment and the 200 reward. Unknown: what the Eye of Argonia really is, what the Collector wants, what the seven towers are, why the Unbound drain and seal trees, how the order listens. Next: get a boat to Skeith Isle and the Grey Tooth.
